observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring schedule, appealing to stability/readiness (conservation) and the capability to execute (competence).
Asserts that an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all, framing rehearsal as the condition for genuine capability (competence) and security (conservation).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the text arguing that a preparedness claim is hollow unless it has been practiced?
